metadata.interpretation: Controlled local-rigidity and static-scene comparison on two accessible BUTom-ST21 tomato development subsets. Oracle boxes discard identities before tracking; actual cached detections are a separate transfer diagnostic. No blueberry accuracy, official benchmark, independent test or superiority claim follows from these experiments.
limitations: Both subsets are from the publisher's evaluation partition, used here for development.
Sequence205 was used for separate encoder development; that encoder is not used here.
Hyperparameters are fixed before execution; this is not a test-set selection sweep.
Static geometry is an assumption to test; occlusion, moving foliage and parallax can break it.
Identical cache hashes and compact descriptors are used within each sequence/mode.
Warm association excludes first five frames; full/cold timing remains in results.
Seed deviation is not uncertainty across independently sampled videos.
